research_latest.text: **Request:** "yes and I also want that portfolio, I want an overview of everything live": add QuantForge-style validation gates, a combined portfolio, and a live overview. No live A/B/C file touched; no real order; no broker. **1. Gates** (`research_hf/gates.py`, `gates_results.json`, `gates_summary.md`; code `pcore.py` runs the live engines `scalp_core.run` / `bk3_core.run` with pre-market overnight range for C): - Rules fixed before the run: trades ≥ 100; real €/trade ≥ 95th percentile of 10,000 random-entry runs; ≥ 70% of nudged copies profitable; 95% bootstrap CI (trading-day blocks) of €/trade > 0; ≥ 4 of 6 time folds profitable; ≥ 2 of 3 markets profitable when run alone. Fixed €500 sizing. - Results at 0.01% (0.02% in brackets): **A** trades PASS, random PASS (99.3rd pct), nudged PASS (97% [71%]), CI FAIL (−0.50 to +5.31 €/trade), k-fold FAIL (3/6: −70, −100, +299, +121, −2, +112), cross-market PASS (SPY +105, QQQ +260, gold −169 transfer test) → 4/6 [4/6]. **B** trades FAIL (76), random PASS (99.9th), nudged PASS (100% [97%]), CI PASS (+0.83 to +7.33) [FAIL −0.70 to +5.4], k-fold PASS (5/6; 2024 H2 −93), cross-market PASS (all 3 positive; gold [−17]) → 5/6 [4/6]. **C** trades PASS (1,559), random PASS (99.7th, but random entries lose even more), nudged FAIL (62% [0%]), CI FAIL (−0.59 to +0.85), k-fold FAIL (3/6), cross-market FAIL (SPY −583, QQQ −144, gold +101) → 2/6 [2/6]. - Nudged copies: 414 extra engine runs (one-at-a-time ±10/±20% and 40 joint random nudges per track and cost). - **Bug found & fixed:** `research_hf/hf_engine.sim` credited the partial (scale-out) profit with the wrong sign for SHORT trades. Effect: round-2 high-frequency variants with scale-outs were understated for shorts; tracks A, C and the live engines never used it. Fixed; kernel parity with the live engine is now exact for B (76/76) and C (1,559/1,559), 93–94% identical for A. **2.
